column6: HH -1ST NORMAL HOUSEHOLDS HEADED BY SCHEDULED TRIBES BY HOUSEHOLD SIZE (Census 2011)

column1: Notes: i)  A household is treated as a Scheduled Tribe household when the head of the household belongs to a Scheduled Tribe.
ii)  Households other than Institutional and Houseless households are Normal households.
iii)  Household size refers to number of persons in a household.

iv)  Population in HH-1ST Table has been arrived at taking into account all the persons in ST headed household irrespective of their ST status, therefore it will not match with ST population given in PCA.
